docs.title: US EV sales report 2026
docs.text:
State of EV Sales in the US


Last Updated: May 2026 - Q1 2026 sales data was verified by analysts.

US electric vehicle sales fell 28% year over year in 2026 as demand cooled, according to Cox Automotive. US electric vehicle sales demand weakened across the US in 2026 as buyers delayed purchases. The federal tax credit expired on September 30, 2025. This led to a sharp drop in EV car purchases across the US market during 2026.

US EV Sales 2026
US electric vehicle sales cratered 28% YoY in 2026 as demand cooled across the country. Registrations remained stronger in coastal states where charging access improved.

EV market share reached 7.8% of new car sales in the US in 2026.
